title: Ācta Diurna · Diēs Lūnae, V Īd. Nov. (Mon 9 Nov 2026)
summary: Canberra 2–21° and mostly sunny, 25° tomorrow; Australia's economy slows: 4.85% cash rate, 3.6% core inflation, Angus Taylor: 'you don't punish growth', Chalmers seeks productivity ideas; Iran: US Task Force Iron Gate targets land routes, 147 ships turned back; US: Senate counts in Mississippi and Alaska, Massie moves to impeach Hegseth; Ukraine: Russia hits the power grid, talks set for Abu Dhabi; Corvo island turns off its lights for seabirds; Opīniō: Rowan Dean on progressive antisemitism and the Segal report; the Lateran Basilica dedicated, AD 324. Every line in English, then Latin; then all the Latin again. Sources: Bureau of Meteorology via WillyWeather; The Spectator Australia (Tony Nikolic, Rowan Dean); ABC News (6 Nov); Fox News and CBS News (7–8 Nov); Yahoo News (7 Nov); Kyiv Independent (8 Nov); Good Good Good (7 Nov).
lines: Hello, listeners. This is the Acta Diurna.
Salvēte, audītōrēs. Haec sunt Ācta Diurna.
Today is Monday, the fifth day before the Ides of November.
Hodiē est diēs Lūnae, ante diem quīntum Īdūs Novembrēs.
First, the weather. Then Australian affairs.
Then the world: Iran, America, Ukraine.
Deinde orbis terrārum: Īrānia, America, Ūcraīna.
Then a happy story, opinion, and today in history.
Tum rēs laeta, opīniō, et hodiē in historiā.
At the end, the words of the day.
The weather. Canberra first: a cold start, then a mostly sunny Monday.
Today in Canberra the sky is mostly clear.
Hodiē Canberrae caelum plērumque serēnum est.
In the morning it is very cold: only 2 degrees.
Māne valdē frīgidum est: duo gradūs tantum.
In the afternoon it is warm: 21 degrees.
Post merīdiem calidum est: ūnus et vīgintī gradūs.
The wind blows from the south, 15 to 20 kilometres an hour.
Ventus ab austrō flat, quīndecim ad vīgintī chiliometra in hōrā.
In the evening the wind changes and becomes light.
Vesperī ventus mūtātur et lēnis fit.
Tomorrow, Tuesday, in the morning there may be fog.
Crās, diē Mārtis, māne fortasse nebula erit.
Then the sky will be mostly clear.
Tomorrow morning 3 degrees, in the afternoon 25.
Crās māne trēs gradūs, post merīdiem quīnque et vīgintī.
Tomorrow the wind will blow from the west and the north.
Crās ventus ab occidente et septentriōnibus flābit.
Ergō: hodiē ūnus et vīgintī gradūs, crās quīnque et vīgintī.
In Canberra today: cold in the morning, warm in the afternoon, and no rain.
Canberrae hodiē māne frīgidum, post merīdiem calidum, et sine pluviā.
In Sydney the sky is partly cloudy. Perhaps a shower at first light. 21 degrees.
Sydnēiae caelum partim nūbilum est. Fortasse prīmā lūce imber. Ūnus et vīgintī gradūs.
In Melbourne the sun is shining. 22 degrees.
Melburnī sōl lūcet. Duo et vīgintī gradūs.
In Brisbane the sky is mostly clear. 26 degrees.
Brisbanae caelum plērumque serēnum est. Sex et vīgintī gradūs.
In Perth the clouds are moving away. 24 degrees.
Perthī nūbēs abeunt. Quattuor et vīgintī gradūs.
In Adelaide perhaps a shower from midday. 27 degrees.
Adēlāidae fortasse imber ā merīdiē. Septem et vīgintī gradūs.
In Adelaide today it is hottest.
In Hobart the sky is cloudy. 19 degrees.
Hobartī caelum nūbilum est. Ūndēvīgintī gradūs.
In most cities the sun is shining.
Only in Sydney and Adelaide will there perhaps be a shower.
Sōlum Sydnēiae et Adēlāidae fortasse imber erit.
Australia. The economy is slowing, rates are at an eighteen-year high, and the Opposition says Labor is punishing growth.
The central bank has already raised the interest rate five times this year.
Argentāria centrālis faenus iam quīnquiēns hōc annō auxit.
The rate is now 4.85 per cent.
Faenus nunc est quattuor per centum et octōgintā quīnque centēsimae.
The rate is the highest for 18 years.
Faenus altissimum est post duodēvīgintī annōs.
On Melbourne Cup Day the rate was raised.
Diē Pōculī Melburnēnsis faenus auctum est.
Six members of the bank voted for the rise, three against.
Sex sodālēs argentāriae prō incrēmentō suffrāgium tulērunt, trēs contrā.
The bank itself says: the economy is getting slower, house prices have fallen, more people are out of work.
Ipsa argentāria dīcit: oeconomia tardior fit, pretia domuum cecidērunt, plūrēs sine opere sunt.
What does this mean for families?
Someone who has a loan of 600,000 dollars now pays about 490 dollars more every month.
Quī sescenta mīlia dollarōrum mūtua habet, nunc circiter quadringentōs nōnāgintā dollarōs plūs quōque mēnse solvit.
More than in January. Every month.
Plūs quam mēnse Iānuāriō. Quōque mēnse.
Core inflation in Australia is 3.6 per cent.
Īnflātiō interior in Austrāliā est tria et sex decimae per centum.
In Britain it is 2.8. In America 2.6.
In Britanniā est duo et octō decimae. In America duo et sex decimae.
So inflation in Australia is higher than in other countries.
Ergō inflātiō in Austrāliā altior est quam in aliīs terrīs.
In September 4.7 per cent were out of work.
Mēnse Septembrī quattuor et septem decimae per centum sine opere erant.
And the government has large debts.
Et rēs pūblica magna dēbita habet.
Dēbita sunt nōngenta septuāgintā ūnum mīlliarda dollarōrum.
Opposition Leader Angus Taylor: you don't punish growth. But that is exactly what this government has done.
Angus Taylor is the leader of the Opposition.
Taylor says: you must not punish growth.
Taylor dīcit: incrēmentum nōn pūnīre dēbēs.
But this government punishes growth, as Taylor says.
Sed haec rēs pūblica incrēmentum pūnit, ut Taylor dīcit.
Taylor says: the new laws on taxes reduce work and enterprise.
Taylor dīcit: novae lēgēs dē vectīgālibus labōrem et industriam minuunt.
Laws on capital gains, on renting out homes, on trusts.
Lēgēs dē lucrō capitālī, dē domibus locandīs, dē fideicommissīs.
Matthew Canavan, a senator, adds: we will abolish the policy called net zero.
Matthaeus Canavan, senātor, addit: nōs cōnsilium quod net zero vocātur abolēbimus.
That way energy prices will come down, as Canavan says.
Sīc pretia energiae dēscendent, ut Canavan dīcit.
The Treasurer, Jim Chalmers, has asked Treasury for productivity ideas for December's budget update.
Chalmers asked the Treasury: give me ideas for boosting productivity.
Chalmers aerārium rogāvit: date mihi cōnsilia dē industriā augendā.
These ideas will be in the new accounts in December.
Haec cōnsilia mēnse Decembrī in novīs ratiōnibus erunt.
But in the Productivity Commission's inquiry, Chalmers does not touch taxes and work laws.
Sed in quaestiōne Commissiōnis Prōductīvitātis Chalmers vectīgālia et lēgēs dē opere nōn tangit.
High interest rates, high inflation, large debts.
Faenus altum, inflātiō alta, dēbita magna.
That is the state of Australia today.
The world. America tightens the blockade on Iran: a new task force, Iron Gate, now targets Iran's land routes too.
The Americans have long been closing Iran's ports.
Americānī portūs Īrāniae iam diū claudunt.
Now they have created a new force. Its name is Iron Gate.
Nunc novam manum creāvērunt. Nōmen eī est Porta Ferrea.
Iron Gate will watch Iran's land routes.
Porta Ferrea viās terrestrēs Īrāniae spectābit.
And it will watch the Caspian Sea too.
It wants to stop weapons, machines, and forbidden money.
Arma, māchinās, et pecūniam vetitam prohibēre vult.
About 20 people are in this force, in Tampa, in Florida.
Circiter vīgintī hominēs in hāc manū sunt, Tampae, in Floridā.
Admiral Brad Cooper says: Iron Gate strengthens our blockade at sea.
Praefectus classis Brad Cooper dīcit: Porta Ferrea obsidiōnem nostram in marī cōnfirmat.
Since July the Americans have turned back 147 ships.
Ā mēnse Iūliō Americānī centum quadrāgintā septem nāvēs āvertērunt.
Five ships, which did not obey, were disabled.
Quīnque nāvēs, quae nōn pārēbant, inūtilēs factae sunt.
And 10 Iranian oil tankers were destroyed.
Et decem nāvēs oleāriae Īrāniae dēlētae sunt.
Trump says: we made small strikes on the island of Qeshm.
Trump dīcit: parvōs ictūs in īnsulam Qeshm fēcimus.
But Trump says: this is not a big new war.
Sed Trump dīcit: hoc nōn est novum bellum magnum.
Iran has sent a new proposal on the nuclear issue through Qatar.
Īrānia prōpositum novum dē rē ātomicā per Qatariam mīsit.
Sed Īrānia adhūc septem condiciōnēs postulat.
Among them: an end to the blockade and an end to sanctions.
Inter eās: fīnem obsidiōnis et fīnem poenārum.
Meanwhile in Yemen the Houthis say the Saudis have killed 33 people.
Interim in Iemeniā Houthī dīcunt Saudiānōs trīgintā trēs hominēs occīdisse.
The blockade remains. Iran is under pressure.
America. After the midterms, two Senate seats are still being counted, and a Republican wants to impeach Defence Secretary Hegseth.
Now the United States of America.
After the elections the Democrats hold Congress.
In the House of Representatives the Democrats have 254 seats.
In Domō Repraesentantium Dēmocratae ducentās quīnquāgintā quattuor sēdēs habent.
In the Senate the Democrats 54, the Republicans 44.
In senātū Dēmocratae quīnquāgintā quattuor, Rēpūblicānī quadrāgintā quattuor.
In Texas James Talarico defeated Ken Paxton.
In Texiā Iacōbus Talarico Kennethum Paxton vīcit.
He is the first Democrat from Texas elected to the Senate since 1988.
Prīmus Dēmocrata ex Texiā in senātum ēlēctus est post annum mīllēsimum nōngentēsimum octōgēsimum octāvum.
In Mississippi Scott Colom is narrowly ahead: by 2,574 votes.
In Mississippiā Scott Colom paulum superat: duōbus mīlibus quīngentīs septuāgintā quattuor suffrāgiīs.
Cindy Hyde-Smith, the Republican senator, is not conceding.
Cindy Hyde-Smith, senātrīx Rēpūblicāna, nōn cēdit.
Hyde-Smith says: we will carry this through to the very end.
Hyde-Smith dīcit: hoc ad fīnem ipsum perferēmus.
Postal votes are accepted until the 10th of November.
Epistulae cum suffrāgiīs usque ad diem decimum Novembris accipiuntur.
In Alaska Mary Peltola, by 637 votes, is ahead of Dan Sullivan, the senator.
In Alaskā Maria Peltola sescentīs trīgintā septem suffrāgiīs Dan Sullivan, senātōrem, superat.
If no one has more than half the votes, a new count begins on the 18th of November.
Sī nēmō plūs quam dīmidium suffrāgiōrum habet, numerātiō nova incipit diē duodēvīcēsimō Novembris.
And Thomas Massie, a Republican, wants to impeach Hegseth, the Secretary of War, unless Hegseth leaves.
Et Thomas Massie, Rēpūblicānus, Hegseth, ministrum bellī, accūsāre vult, nisi Hegseth discēdit.
Perhaps as soon as next week.
Hegseth says: this did not work against Trump, and it will not work against me.
Hegseth dīcit: hoc nōn valuit contrā Trump, nec valēbit contrā mē.
Ukraine. Russia is hitting Ukraine's power grid before winter, as new peace talks are set for Abu Dhabi.
The Russians are attacking Ukraine's power stations.
Zelensky says that stations in 6 regions have been damaged.
Zelensky dīcit stātiōnēs in sex regiōnibus laesās esse.
Among them Kyiv, Kharkiv, and Dnipro.
Inter eās Kiovia, Charcovia, et Dnipro.
In one day 2 people were killed, 37 wounded.
Ūnō diē duo hominēs occīsī sunt, trīgintā septem vulnerātī.
Russian missiles also hit Kyiv itself.
Missilia Russica etiam Kioviam ipsam percussērunt.
Kyiv's North Bridge was damaged. At least 6 were wounded.
Pōns Septentriōnālis Kioviae laesus est. Sex saltem vulnerātī sunt.
Winter is coming, and the Russians want to take away light and heat.
Hiems venit, et Russī lūcem et calōrem auferre volunt.
But the Ukrainians are fighting too.
Ukrainian missiles, which are called Neptune, hit a Russian factory in the city of Oryol.
Missilia Ūcraīna, quae Neptūnus vocantur, officīnam Russicam in urbe Oryol percussērunt.
Meanwhile new talks on peace are being prepared, in the city of Abu Dhabi.
Interim novī sermōnēs dē pāce parantur, in urbe Abu Dhabi.
Russia will send Sergei Ryabkov, the deputy foreign minister.
Russia Sergium Ryabkov, vicārium ministrī rērum exterārum, mittet.
Rustem Umerov will lead the Ukrainian delegation.
Zelensky says: Putin does not want to stop the fighting.
Zelensky dīcit: Putin pugnam sistere nōn vult.
The war gets harsher in winter.
Something good. On a tiny island in the Azores, everyone turns off the lights, to help young seabirds find the sea.
Corvo is a small island, in the Azores, in the Atlantic Ocean.
Corvo parva īnsula est, in Azōribus, in Ōceanō Atlanticō.
About 450 people live on the island.
In īnsulā circiter quadringentī quīnquāgintā hominēs habitant.
Every autumn the islanders put out the lights.
For 5 nights the whole island is dark.
Quīnque noctēs tōta īnsula obscūra est.
Young shearwaters fly to the sea at night.
Puffīnī iuvenēs noctū ad mare volant.
The town's lights deceive them. The birds fall to the ground.
Lūcēs urbis eōs dēcipiunt. Avēs in terram cadunt.
But in the darkness the birds find the way to the sea.
Sed in tenebrīs avēs viam ad mare inveniunt.
The islanders on Corvo have been doing this since 2019.
Hoc incolae Corvō faciunt ab annō bis mīllēsimō ūndēvīcēsimō.
A small island, a great work.
And in Chile, in Patagonia, other birds are being saved.
Et in Chīliā, in Patagoniā, aliae avēs servantur.
Women wardens are raising 13 large birds.
Fēminae custōdēs tredecim avēs magnās alunt.
These birds are called Darwin's rheas. They cannot fly, but they run fast.
Hae avēs rheae Darwinī vocantur. Volāre nōn possunt, sed celeriter currunt.
Soon they will be released into freedom.
Tredecim avēs, et multae manūs bonae.
Opinion. This is the view of Rowan Dean, editor of The Spectator Australia: today's antisemitism comes mostly from the progressive side.
This is the view of Rowan Dean, in The Spectator Australia.
Haec est sententia Rowan Dean, in Spectātōre Austrāliānō.
Jillian Segal is the envoy against hatred of Jews.
Iūliāna Segal lēgāta est contrā odium Iūdaeōrum.
Segal has written an updated report.
Segal says: a new, progressive hatred of Jews is now most visible in Australia.
Segal dīcit: odium Iūdaeōrum novum et prōgressīvum nunc maximē in Austrāliā patet.
Dean praises it: at last someone in power has told the truth.
Dean laudat: tandem aliquis in potestāte vēritātem dīxit.
Dean says: this hatred lurks in Labor, in the Greens, and in public radio and television.
Dean dīcit: hoc odium apud Labōrānōs, apud Viridēs, et in radiophōniā et tēlevīsiōne pūblicā latet.
First: a new external watchdog for the ABC and SBS.
Prīmum: novus custōs externus prō ABC et SBS.
Next: visas must be checked more carefully.
And: no public money for artists who encourage hatred of Jews.
Et: nūlla pecūnia pūblica artificibus quī odium Iūdaeōrum fovent.
That is the opinion of Rowan Dean.
On this day, in the year three hundred and twenty-four, the Lateran Basilica in Rome was dedicated.
Today, in the year 324, the Lateran Basilica was dedicated.
Hodiē, annō trecentēsimō vīcēsimō quārtō, basilica Laterānēnsis dēdicāta est.
Pope Sylvester dedicated it, in Rome.
The Emperor Constantine had given the site.
This basilica is the Pope's cathedral church, as Bishop of Rome.
Haec basilica ecclēsia cathedrālis Pāpae est, ut Episcopī Rōmānī.
Not St Peter's, but the Lateran.
On the wall it is written: mother and head of all the churches of the City and of the World.
In mūrō scrīptum est: omnium Urbis et Orbis ecclēsiārum māter et caput.
Today the Church still celebrates this feast day.
Hodiē quoque Ecclēsia hunc diem festum celebrat.
Marcus and Lucius, as always, were there. But that is another story.
Mārcus et Lūcius, ut semper, aderant. Sed id alia fābula est.

Canberrae hodiē caelum serēnum est. Ūnus et vīgintī gradūs.
Tomorrow it will be warmer: 25 degrees.
Crās calidius erit: quīnque et vīgintī gradūs.
Australia's economy is getting slower, and the interest rate is high.
Oeconomia Austrāliae tardior fit, et faenus altum est.
Inflation in Australia is higher than in Britain and in America.
Īnflātiō in Austrāliā altior est quam in Britanniā et in America.

Taylor dīcit: haec rēs pūblica incrēmentum pūnit.

Chalmers cōnsilia dē industriā ab aerāriō petit.

Americānī novam manum creāvērunt: Portam Ferream.

Porta Ferrea viās terrestrēs Īrāniae spectābit.
In America two Senate seats are still undecided.
In America duae sēdēs senātūs adhūc incertae sunt.

Novī sermōnēs dē pāce in urbe Abu Dhabi parantur.

In īnsulā Corvō incolae lūcēs prō avibus exstinguunt.

Haec sunt Ācta Diurna. Valēte, audītōrēs. Crās iterum.
Now everything again, in Latin only.
